title: NTA CSIR UGC NET June Online Form 2026
fullContentHtml:
Short Details : National Testing Agency (NTA-CSIR UGC NET) has released the notification for the CSIR UGC NET June 2026 Examination on the official website of the NTA recently. The online application process for NTA CSIR UGC NET June Online Form 2026 has started on 27 May 2026, and candidates can apply till 19 June 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for NTA CSIR UGC NET June Online Form 2026 , which are given below.

National Testing Agency (NTA)

NTA CSIR UGC NET June Online Form 2026

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 27 May 2026
  • Last Date : 19 June 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 20 June 2026
  • Correction Date : 22-23 June 2026
  • Exam Date : 17, 18 July 2026
  • Exam City Intimation : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General : Rs. 1150/-
  • EWS, OBC NCL : Rs. 600/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 325/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

NTA CSIR UGC NET June Online Form 2026 : Age Limit

  • Maximum Age : 30 Years for JRF Only
  • Maximum Age : No Limit for Lectureship (LS) / Assistant Professor
  • Age Relaxation as per NTA CSIR UGC NET June Online Form Rules.
  • Use Tool –

NTA CSIR UGC NET June Online Form 2026 : Exam Details

  • Exam Name : NTA CSIR UGC NET Examination June 2026

NTA CSIR UGC NET June Online Form 2026 : Educational Qualification

  • Candidates who have M.Sc / Equivalent Degree with 55% Marks (For General / OBC) & 50% Marks (For SC / ST and PH) will be eligible for this admission.
  • Candidates who have Integrated Course and B.E / B.Tech / B.Pharma and MBBS will also be eligible for this admission.

NTA CSIR UGC NET June Online Form 2026 : Subject Available

  • Chemical Science
  • Earth, Atmospheric, Ocean and Planetary Science
  • Life Science
  • Mathematical Science
  • Physical Science

NTA CSIR UGC NET June Online Form 2026 : Mode of Selection

  • Selection will be based on Online Examination

NTA CSIR UGC NET June Online Form 2026 : How To Apply

  • Candidates can apply through link https://csirnet.nta.nic.in/ or provided below in link section or they can also apply through official site of the NTA CSIR UGC NET Form before Last Date.
  • You Can Check other  Notification Here –
  • For all the interested and eligible candidates who want to apply for NTA CSIR UGC NET June Online Form can read all the information related to the online form is given below and the link to apply is given in the Important Link section below.
  • Note – छात्रो से ये अनुरोध किया जाता है की वो अपना फॉर्म भरने से पहले Official Notification (Last Date, Age Limit, Qualification) को ध्यान से जरूर पढे उसके बाद ही अपना फॉर्म भरे ।

Q. What is Age Limit For NTA CSIR UGC NET June Online Form 2026?
Answer. The age of the candidates applying for this online form as per NTA CSIR UGC NET rules, see the post wise age information in the official information.

Answer. To apply for this online form, first of all you have to go to the Official Sarkari Result which is SarkariExam.com and apply through this recruitment page. Through Sarkari Result Official you can apply for many government jobs.
